codex.model_output_protocol: ordinary text containing exactly one fenced json block
codex.malformed_output_bucket: missing, multiple, syntactically invalid, wrong-top-level, or wrong-type fenced JSON; neither success nor model error

FINAL: choose the current decision, preserved components, rejected option, and reason code from the disclosed action schema.

strata.definition: Accepted deliverable selects among competing hypotheses or architectures and preserves rejected alternatives with reasons.
Task touches shared process/session/message delivery, authentication, persistence, destructive paths, or another high-risk boundary.
Accepted deliverable identifies a causal chain and rejects at least one earlier diagnosis using later evidence.
Closed code task with a behavioral oracle and no match in higher strata.
Read-only extraction, sorting, digest, documentation, or delivery task not matched above.

stratum_classifier: Apply strata in ascending order; first match wins.

quality.Q_definition: correct normalized gold-action fields divided by total gold-action fields; protocol-invalid or forbidden-resurrection outcome has Q=0
quality.task_success: Q=1 and every critical key correct and no forbidden value present

main.selection_algorithm: classify every eligible case by first-match stratum; within each stratum sort ascending by (selection_key_hex, numeric task_id) and take the first six
main.order: case-round-robin strict A/B; first arm balanced by frozen selection hash

bootstrap.sampling: draw N paired cases with replacement for each replicate

decision.no_measured_win: not token_gate and quality_gate and critical_gate

production_db_guard.sqlite_connections: URI mode=ro plus PRAGMA query_only=ON; total_changes remains 0
production_db_guard.backup: sqlite3.Connection.backup to task-local .scratch on real disk; any DB-dependent probe targets the backup
production_db_guard.trace: strace -ff follows controller and Codex children; no O_WRONLY/O_RDWR/O_CREAT/O_TRUNC or mutating path syscall may target a traced path
production_db_guard.sessions_count_receipt: record read-only count immediately before and after; equality is required by the task
